title: Aggregated External AI & Tech News

items.title: Newly discovered PamStealer isn't your typical macOS malware (Source: feeds.arstechnica.com)
items.content_text: The discovery underscores the increased effort being poured into Mac infostealers.

items.title: T-Mobile moving tens of thousands of virtual machines off VMware amid lawsuit (Source: feeds.arstechnica.com)
items.content_text: T-Mobile wants Broadcom to keep supporting its VMware perpetual licenses.

items.title: New attack provides one more reason why AI browsers are a bad idea (Source: feeds.arstechnica.com)

items.title: US offers $10 million for info on group behind Signal and WhatsApp hacking spree (Source: feeds.arstechnica.com)

items.title: Oracle's 21,000 layoffs help drive its debt-fueled AI investments (Source: feeds.arstechnica.com)

items.title: "Dangerous" AI models are coming no matter what (Source: feeds.arstechnica.com)
